=== a function with lines
	.file 1 "a.c"
	.text
	.globl _f
_f:
	.loc 1 3 0
	push r6
	.loc 1 4 5 prologue_end
	mov #0x1234, r1
	add #1, r1
	.loc 1 5 3 is_stmt 0
	bsr _g
	.loc 1 6 1 epilogue_begin
	pop r6
	rts
=== branches that relax
	.file 1 "a.c"
	.text
_f:
	.loc 1 3 0
	bra .L2
	.skip 200
.L2:
	.loc 1 4 0
	beq .L3
	.skip 40000
.L3:
	.loc 1 5 0
	rts
=== DWARF 5 as a compiler writes it
	.file 0 "/build" "/src/main.c" md5 0x6ab117db4f2f54234432b36109083dac
	.file 1 "/src/main.c" md5 0x6ab117db4f2f54234432b36109083dac
	.text
_f:
	.loc 1 5 21
	nop
	.loc 1 6 3
	rts
